AC4: "With Codex mode `skip`, no Codex file is written or modified and the command output says Codex was skipped." -> "With Codex mode `skip`, no Codex file is written and the command output says Codex was skipped; the only change to a Codex file is removing an `AGENTS.override.md` that keryx itself generated (it carries keryx's provenance line), so a leftover cannot keep hiding `AGENTS.md`." (T12 removes a keryx-generated override in skip mode so it stops replacing AGENTS.md for Codex; the old wording forbade that removal, which would defeat skip (request item 7: nothing left in two places). T11 flagged the conflict.)

AC7: "After init and after update, `git check-ignore` reports `CLAUDE.local.md`, `AGENTS.override.md` and `.claude/settings.local.json` as ignored, with missing ones added to `info/exclude`." -> "After init and after update, `git check-ignore` reports every local target the manifest uses (by default `CLAUDE.local.md`, `AGENTS.override.md` and `.claude/settings.local.json`) as ignored, with missing ones added to `info/exclude`." (Under shared scope or Codex skip a file is not a local target and is not written, so requiring it to be ignored was unconditional where the request (item 6) scopes it to local targets. T11 flagged it.)
